record.question: Which of the following statements about 'Suspension' is not correct according to Section 92 of the Mizoram Police Act, 2011?
options: A police officer of or above the rank of SP may place a police officer of the rank of Sub-Inspector or below subordinate to him, under suspension.
Every order of suspension passed shall be in writing, giving briefly the reasons.
An order of suspension so made shall be reviewed every 60 (sixty) days by a Review Committee.

Where an officer is placed under suspension, the authority competent to place him under suspension may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, direct that the officer shall continue to be under suspension until the completion of all or any of the proceedings against him.
